what: Every character and decoration picture in the story, by role. Pencil.
how: file: the new drawing's path, relative to the app folder (e.g. img/characters/older_idle.png); null = use the fallback (Fire Detectives art in img/fire_detectives/). Each picture is fitted inside boxWidth x boxHeight (stage pixels: the stage is 1920 x 1080) without distortion or cropping, bottom-anchored. A file that fails to load falls back too. Optional 'accent': a color like #2f5bd8 to use for that camera instead of reading it from the drawing.

older_idle.where: Slide 1 (cast line), the title, the lift-off; small guide beside MODIS's numbers on slides 3, 4, 5, 6 and the extras. Its main accent sets the older camera's color (--cam-older) unless 'accent' is given

older_looking.alt: The older satellite looking hard at the ground, searching
older_looking.where: Slide 1: drawn large over the wetland while only the older camera's view shows

older_puzzled.alt: The older satellite a little puzzled or squinting
older_puzzled.where: Slide 1, last press: drawn large beside the newer camera's view

older_sign.alt: The older satellite holding up a blank sign
older_sign.where: Slide 2, both presses: above its half of the chart (the years to 2021)

newer_idle.where: Slide 1 (cast line), the title, the lift-off; small guide beside VIIRS's numbers on slides 3, 4 and the extras. Its main accent sets the newer camera's color (--cam-newer) unless 'accent' is given

newer_looking.alt: The newer satellite looking hard at the ground, searching
newer_looking.where: Slide 1: drawn large over the wetland before the newer camera's view is shown

newer_surprised.alt: The newer satellite surprised or proud: 'I see so many!'
newer_surprised.where: Slide 1, last press: drawn large while its own view shows

newer_sign.alt: The newer satellite holding up a blank sign
newer_sign.where: Slide 2, both presses: above its half of the chart (the years from 2022)

detective_thinking.alt: The detective thinking, with the notebook
detective_thinking.where: Slide 1, second press; slide 2, first press: asking the question in a speech bubble

detective_aha.where: Slide 2, second press: 'Aha! Put them on one scale first.'

both_together.alt: Both satellites side by side, happy, like teammates
both_together.where: The title, the landing into slide 6, and small beside 'one scale' on slides 6 and 7

detective_point.alt: The kid detective pointing at something on the board
detective_point.where: Slide 2, second press: pointing at where the jump starts
